BackupManifest.title: BackupManifest
BackupManifest.description: Metadata manifest for a user's daily encrypted/chunked ledger backup snapshot.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this backup.

backupDate.description: ISO calendar date of the daily snapshot (yyyy-MM-dd).

chunkCount.description: Total number of ordered payload chunks in the chunks subcollection.

totalBytes.description: Total UTF-8 character/byte length across all backup chunks.

verified.description: True once every chunk write has committed cleanly before retention pruning.

customerCount.description: Number of customers included in this backup snapshot.

transactionCount.description: Number of customer transactions included in this backup snapshot.

hasUserProfile.description: Whether this snapshot includes userProfile metadata and avatar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when snapshot was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

BackupChunk.title: BackupChunk
BackupChunk.description: Ordered UTF-8 JSON chunk belonging to a BackupManifest.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns the parent backup.

backupId.description: Document ID of the parent BackupManifest.

chunkIndex.description: Zero-based index of this chunk within the parent backup.

payload.description: UTF-8 JSON substring payload segment for this chunk.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: Daily user-scoped cloud backup manifests (7-day retention).

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}/chunk.description: Chunked backup JSON segments scoped under the parent BackupManifest.
